headline: Approved $320,000.00 for Gore Place windows, $85,000 for Community Day Center, and $50,768.00 for First Parish Church steeple.
summary: The committee approved three requests for funds from the CPA Historic Preservation account. The projects are steeple work at First Parish Church, window restoration at Gore Place, and exterior restoration of the Community Day Center at 20 Felton Street.
decisions: Approved the June 1, 2026 minutes by voice vote.
Approved $50,768.00 in additional funds for steeple restoration at First Parish Church by voice vote.
Approved $320,000.00 for restoring forty-three windows at Gore Place by voice vote.
Approved $85,000 for exterior restoration of the Community Day Center at 20 Felton Street by voice vote.

plain_text:
Long Term Debt Committee 
October 5, 2026 
Minutes of the Meeting 
 
Attendance 
Councillor Durkee   Present 
Councillor Hanley   Present 
Councillor King   Present 
Councillor LaCava   Present 
Councillor Bradley-MacArthur Present 
 
Chairman Durkee called the meeting to order at 6:00 pm.  
 
Councillor Hanley moved approval of June 1, 2026, minutes.  Motion was adopted on a 
voice vote. 
 
Councillor King moved to hear from all off-committee members.  Motion was adopted on 
a voice vote. 
 
1. CPC requests for additional funds in the amount of $50,768.00 to be allocated 
from the CPA Historic Preservation account for the steeple preservation and 
restoration project at the First Parish Church at 50 Church Street. 
 
CPC Chairman Justin Barrett appeared before the committee. Mr. Barrett said this 
project had issues with the first contractor and additional funds are needed to finish 
the project.  Councillor Hanley asked if the money was lost.  Mr. Barrett said no 
funds were lost.  Councillor King asked if any legal action was needed.  Mr. Barrett 
said no legal action is needed.  Councillor Hanley made a motion for approval. 
Motion was approved on a voice vote.   
 
2. CPC requests for funds in the amount of $320,000.00 to be allocated from the 
CPA Historic Preservation account for the restoration of forty-three south facing-
facing windows at Gore Place. 
 
CPC Chairman Justin Barrett appeared before the committee. Mr. Barrett said this  
Project was approved unanimously by the CPC.  Councillor LaCava said these 
windows are in dire need of repair.  Councillor LaCava also mentioned how much 
The Gore Place gives back to the City.  Councillor LaCava made a motion for 
approval. Motion was approved on a voice vote.
3. CPC requests for funds in the amount of $85,000 to be allocated from the CPA 
Historic Preservation account for the exterior restoration of the Community Day 
Center at 20 Felton Street  
 
CPC Chairman Justin Barrett and Ms. Chloe Crouch from the Community Day 
Center appeared before the committee.  Mr. Barrett said this project was approved 
unanimously by the CPC.  Mr. Barrett said these funds will be used to rehab three-
quarters of the building. Mr. Barrett said no work is being done to the adjacent ally.  
Councillor Hanley asked when this project will start.  Ms. Crouch said they plan on 
starting the project this year. Councillor Bradley-MacArthur asked what this project 
will mean to their organization.  Ms. Chouch said this upgrade will help them with 
providing all their services at this location. Councillor Hanley made a motion for 
approval. Motion was approved on a voice vote. 
 
Councillor Bradley-MacArhtur moved to adjourn.  Motion was adopted and the 
meeting was adjourned at 6:09 pm. 
 
Respectfully submitted, 
Thamas J. Magno - Clerk
